question: What is the name of the campaign launched by the Bihar government to reach out to women beneficiaries?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Mahila Samvad**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Bihar Govt launches Mahila Samvad campaign to reach 2 crore women.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
The **Bihar government** launched the **Mahila Samvad campaign** to reach out to **women beneficiaries** and other stakeholders.

 
 
• 
 
The campaign was **inaugurated by Chief Minister Nitish Kumar** and will run for the next **two months**.

 
 
• 
 
**Target:** Reach out to **2 crore women** across **70,000 locations** in the state.

 
 
• 
 
The campaign will promote **women empowerment schemes** of the Nitish Kumar-led government and collect **feedback**.

 
 
• 
 
**Audio-visual publicity**: Specially designed **mobile vans** will be used to inform people about various women empowerment initiatives, such as:

 
 
• 
 
**Women reservation in Panchayati Raj institutions** and **government jobs**.

 
 
• 
 
**Economic empowerment** through **self-help groups**, **entrepreneurship schemes**, and **Jeevika livelihood programmes**.

 
 
 
 
• 
 
**1.35 lakh Jeevika groups** will participate in the dialogue to gather feedback.

 
 
• 
 
The aim is to analyze the **effectiveness of women-centric programmes** and address any issues or gaps identified through the feedback.
